answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a harbor checkpoint. The vertex chain is verified at intake and fable publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1928 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
